message.content:
N. (severity HIGH) — Cost Stack / BoM
   Finding: Raw BoM listed at £1,801 yet query states £4,969 total; unit prices for major R290 components (e.g. Copeland YP0135E-TFD-290 at ~£113) are unrealistically low compared with real distributor data, inflating apparent regression from iter-2.
   Evidence: "Raw materials BoM £1,801.09 … 137 part lines … ~ ESTIMATE"
   Root cause: Engine B pricing curve fallback (0.580× multiplier on £600 reference) applied without live quotes or R290-specific correction.
   Fix: Replace all ~ ESTIMATE lines for compressor, inverter PCB, Grundfos pump and heat exchangers with current DigiKey/Mouser distributor prices before re-running cost aggregation.

N. (severity HIGH) — Module 4 / Compressor
   Finding: Specified compressor (YP0135E-TFD-290) is 380–420 V 3-phase, incompatible with UK residential 230 V single-phase supply.
   Evidence: "Copeland YP0135E-TFD-290 … motor code 'TFD' … 3-phase 380-420V motor"
   Root cause: Module 4 sub-module 4.1 did not constrain motor code to PFJ/PFJ-series single-phase R290 models.
   Fix: Change part number to Copeland YP0135E-PFJ-290 (or equivalent 230 V/1 ph model) and update inverter drive rating to 16–20 A single-phase.

N. (severity HIGH) — Module 2 / Fan
   Finding: 140 mm 80 W centrifugal blower cannot deliver the ~3,000–4,300 m³/h airflow required for an 8 kW evaporator.
   Evidence: "ebm-papst G2E140-BL31-01 … 80 W … <500 m³/h … mathematically insufficient"
   Root cause: Air-management sub-module used wrong fan class; axial fan diameter and static-pressure data omitted.
   Fix: Replace with ebm-papst 500 mm HyBlade axial fan (e.g. A5D500) rated ≥3,000 m³/h and re-calculate evaporator sizing.

N. (severity MED) — Refrigerant compatibility
   Finding: Multiple non-R290-rated components (e.g. standard EPDM gaskets, non-A3-rated relays) remain in the refrigerant circuit despite brief mandating R290.
   Evidence: "Trelleborg base pan gasket … EPDM rubber" and "Finder 40.31 relay" listed without R290 suffix.
   Root cause: Sub-module 1.1 and 4.4 parts lists copied from generic templates without A3-material filter.
   Fix: Add "-R290" suffix or swap to HNBR/PTFE equivalents for all wetted seals and EX-rated relays.

N. (severity MED) — Target feasibility
   Finding: £1,800 OEM target is achievable in principle for an 8 kW R290 monobloc but current design exceeds it once realistic compressor (£280–£350), fan (£90) and certification costs are inserted.
   Evidence: "maximum OEM unit cost of £1,800" vs. "£440 per kW thermal installed — 27% below typical"
   Root cause: Cost-stack multiplier (0.325) and 137 web-estimate prices calibrated on <3 kW units, not 8 kW class.
   Fix: Re-run BoM with volume-adjusted distributor quotes and add explicit £25–£40k certification line item before claiming target compliance.
